# Bad newbie experience - tutorial broken and other issues

I wanna create my first mobile app and have been referred to FlutterFlow. My first impression was really great - but after signing up and some initial tests I hit a couple of really annoying problems.

1. The In App Tutorial "Build your first app in 10 min" is broken. - It is not possible to navigate to the profile page! Basically, the profile Icon is not clickable. I searched the web but did not find any solution, just 2 links which proof that the problem already exist for more than 2 month and has not been fixed yet! [...] 1. 
4. Complicated login to community -> At first I was not able to login to the community pages. I click on login and was presented with the login screen, I clicked on "Login with FlutterFlow" and ended up in my project. Nothing else happened, no redirect to the community and still not logged in to the community. I did it three more times with no success until I realized that there was a community link in the project space sidebar. Doh! why not use a redirect or cross-tab authentication? -> Bad UX.
5. Can not deploy to mobile phone for testing - The broken links in the tutorial and the barcode scanner issue seem to occur only in Preview and Demo mode. However, I cannot deploy to my device with the free account. This was not obvious when I signed up.

results.content:
The responses I received were long and polite but did nothing to solve my actual problem. They tried to justify the broken service with confusing explanations about credits and system updates, but this does not change the fact that I paid for something I couldn’t use.

Overall, this has been a frustrating experience. I would not recommend spending money on FlutterFlow until they fix these critical issues and start taking responsibility for their service.

results.content:
I never actively signed up for this new recurring subscription. I never authorized a new recurring payment commitment. FlutterFlow unilaterally decided to turn my purchase into a subscription.

I cancelled immediately and requested a full refund. So far, no one has replied.

After more than two years as a customer, the trust is broken. I'm now looking for another solution to migrate my apps to a different environment.

UPDATE – August 11, 2026

FlutterFlow has responded and will issue a full refund. They have also agreed to remove my payment information from their system at my request.

Credit where it's due: they resolved my complaint properly. [...] Based on 44 reviews

Review FlutterFlow?

Reviewers mostly see FlutterFlow as a fast, capable way to build and launch apps without heavy coding, especially for prototyping, client work, and small startup products. They praise its strong builder UI, rapid iteration, useful integrations, and the ability to extend projects with custom code when needed. But the praise comes with clear friction: users repeatedly mention bugs, weak debugging, slow or inconsistent support, vague tutorials, and some publishing or storage limits. Several reviewers also say pricing changes and scaling beyond basic apps can make it harder to recommend.

Flutterflow blew me away the instant I got my hands on it. My assumption was "Ok, this is just another service that promises a lot, but I can build one pager at best and it will look crappy", but boy was I wrong. Features like integration with Firestore, ability to build working CRUD, authentication, and much more. And users can build apps extremely fast, I got my app up and running in 8 hours. The only thing I would see as a drawback is their Youtube tutorial channel. The videos are a bit vague and improvements could be made. Other than that, I absolutely love FlutterFlow. Hats off to the creators!
